analysis: The PR changes two call sites in ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift: the local-work gate in throwIfRefusingNewLocalWork (head line 135) and the coordinator-request autopilot gate (head line 513). Both swap autopilotAllowsModel for autopilotServesModel. The surrounding control flow is unchanged. The gate at line 513 still runs after the admission awaits and before inference_accepted (line 523) and the requestToModel registration (line 528). There is no suspension between them, so atomicity is preserved. It still rejects with a 503 capacity error through lookupReceiptFinalizer. No new data paths, logging of decrypted content, or encryption changes are introduced. Decrypt, parse and deadline handling, receipt settlement, and the response hash and attestation path in the base unit (lines 1144-1556) are untouched. I checked the base unit for T-008, T-041 and T-010 interactions and saw no change. The open question is the semantics of autopilotServesModel, which is defined outside the supplied evidence. If it is more permissive than autopilotAllowsModel, for example if it admits models not selected by autopilot or not advertised, the gate would be weaker. That cannot be verified from this diff. The definition and its other callers need a check that it is at least as restrictive, and that models outside the managed or advertised set are still refused. No concrete regression is supported by the visible evidence.
